text.title: user-flows.md Template Decision Tree
text.summary: User-facing-flow gate first, then existence and shape checks on the artefact. Routes to produce / a specific rule / skip; every conclusion references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the feature have any user-facing flow — the user takes a sequence of actions (page navigation, form submission, button click, command invocation)?

branch.conclusion: Backend-only: no user-flows.md. Verify through API tests in `tests/api/` (worker → unit + integration; migration → migration test + reversibility check).
Produce it from templates/user-flows.md.tmpl before the feature can be promoted to done/.

branch.question: Does every flow pass the shape checks?

branch.conclusion: Add the missing field(s): Actor, Preconditions, Happy path, Negative paths, Playwright spec path.
Add at least one negative case from the unsexy-edge list — auth, network, invalid input, race, boundary.
State the trigger and the expected error UX (what the user sees, where).
Give every step an expected result; put the success criterion in the final step.
Name one spec file per flow; the mapping is 1:1.
The artefact passes; the reviewer ticks readiness.md item 6 with the spec results as evidence.
Outside the SDD feature lifecycle, or the project has no Playwright (or equivalent) for E2E; nothing to map to.

text.example: inputs: {flow=stripe checkout page, in_progress=true, playwright=true, user-flows.md exists, F-01: 3 happy cases, 0 negatives} q-user-facing -> true q-exists -> true q-shape -> negative_paths == 0 => conclusion pos-and-neg-per-flow: add card-declined negative (trigger + expected UX), then re-run; all_shape_checks_pass -> run-the-checklist.
